note: Independent rejudgment against the complete RFC 8050, Sections 2 and 3. Section 3 says, "These enhancements continue to encapsulate the entire BGP message in the BGP message field." The live collision test retains the winning TCP connection and exact directional OPEN occurrences, then compares complete isolated classic and MP announcements and withdrawals against received subtypes 9/4 and sent subtypes 11/7. Its ordinary-family controls distinguish per-family and per-direction ADD-PATH from a global flag. The observer matrix separately covers both BGP4MP and BGP4MP_ET, every NLRI location, exact record count, subtype and unchanged complete message bytes. The changed collision helper now reports full-stream context ambiguity explicitly; its separately retained known-connection context uses only the actual winning OPEN occurrences, never synthesized settings. This change does not remove the subtype or byte-preservation assertions. observeReceivedWire reads the receive context; the retained writer carries its own send context and transport. OnBGPMessage selects updateAddPath from the actual UPDATE's family fields and preserves the original message. No TABLE_DUMP_V2 or new foreign-parser execution is claimed.
